Method of Attack: Exploitation of CVE-2021-43890 Windows AppX Installer spoofing vulnerability to bypass Defender SmartScreen and browser alerts
Distribution of malware via signed malicious MSIX application packages
Use of ms-appinstaller URI scheme to distribute malware
Malicious advertisements and Microsoft Teams phishing messages to push malicious packages
Spoofing Windows AppX Installer to distribute malware like Emotet and BazarLoader
Abuse of ms-appinstaller protocol handler as access vector for malware leading to ransomware distribution
Attack Vector: Malicious packages hosted on Microsoft Azure (*.web.core.windows.net URLs)
